Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so do not stay in her attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley sideways, and keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns you, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove the crowd control.
Ashe.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Ashe P Frost Shot, Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and Ashe W Volley. Boots of Swiftness are the default for the movement speed to find an engage angle, but choose Plated Steelcaps if the enemy team deals mostly physical damage. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus ends. Do not spend too long walking toward Ashe and getting repeatedly slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot; close the gap at once with Alistar W Headbutt. Engage when your ADC can follow up.
Ashe.laning: Right after dodging Ashe W Volley sideways, look for an Alistar Q Pulverize angle when Ashe steps forward to last hit. If you use Alistar W Headbutt with Alistar Q Pulverize and miss, you will be counterattacked, so hold your engage when the angle is uncertain. Mind your early mana and trade with Alistar E Trample while waiting for an opening.
Ashe.combo: If you can reach Ashe, knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt, then follow with Alistar E Trample to try to stun her. To send Ashe toward your team, first get behind her and use Alistar W Headbutt, or knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize and then push her with Alistar W Headbutt.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability to create distance herself, so the moment after she uses Ashe W Volley is an opportunity to engage. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, keep your distance until it ends, then engage with Alistar W Headbutt. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow catches you, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove the crowd control and reduce incoming damage.
Ashe.phase: In mid game, look for an engage after Ashe W Volley is used when your team can follow up. In late game, Alistar deals very little damage, so focus on starting fights or protecting your team.
Ashe.teamfight: When you have an angle to reach Ashe, disrupt her position with Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize, then follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample. Activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will if Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow catches you or you start taking focused fire. If an enemy reaches your backline, peel them off with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it connects with a wall or a second target, so avoid standing with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Reassess your attack timing while Bard R Tempered Fate makes its targets immune to damage.
Bard.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the area of a telegraphed attack. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Bard's damage.
Bard.fight: After Bard E Magical Journey is used, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for crowd control. Before engaging, check whether your ADC can follow up. If the angle is uncertain, save the mana heavy Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize combo and trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Bard.combo: If Bard E Magical Journey is used, engage with Alistar W Headbutt into Alistar Q Pulverize and follow through to the stun from Alistar E Trample. To send Bard toward your team, first get behind him and use Alistar W Headbutt. For a catch from unexpected range, Flash during the cast of Alistar Q Pulverize to shift its area, then push Bard toward your team with Alistar W Headbutt.
Bard.escape: The moment after forcing Bard E Magical Journey is an opportunity to engage. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also used, you do not need to wait to avoid its stun; close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt.
Bard.phase: In mid game, look to engage as soon as Bard E Magical Journey is used. In late game, Alistar deals very little damage, so focus on starting fights or protecting your team.
Bard.teamfight: Use Alistar W Headbutt to push an enemy damage dealer toward your team, or Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. Activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will right after enemy crowd control catches you or you start taking focused fire, then disrupt the enemy formation. Bard R Tempered Fate makes both allies and enemies immune to damage, so reassess when to attack a target under its effect.
Bard.laning: Step on Bard W Caretaker's Shrine as you pass to remove it. When the enemy steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to use Alistar Q Pulverize, while avoiding positions in a straight line with a wall, an ally, or a minion so Bard Q Cosmic Binding cannot stun you.

Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank E Power Fist can knock you up and Blitzcrank R Static Field can silence you. Stand behind minions in lane to avoid Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and keep well away from bushes without vision. If caught, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the crowd control and reduce damage when you come under focused fire.
Blitzcrank.build: For your first defensive purchase, prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. If you keep getting locked down by his crowd control chain, consider tenacity first. Magic resistance does not reduce the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist, and Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so do not rely on a shield to survive.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or Blitzcrank is low on mana. If your ADC can follow up, close in with Alistar W Headbutt and chain the crowd control from Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If the engage angle is uncertain, save the mana heavy combo and trade with Alistar E Trample.
Blitzcrank.laning: Always keep minions in front of you, and secure vision of the bushes with a Control Ward. Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, gain an advantage by pushing the lane or trading. Watch Blitzcrank's mana bar and engage when your ADC can follow up.
Blitzcrank.combo: When engaging, knock the target up with Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt, then follow with Alistar E Trample to try to stun them. If you need to push an enemy toward your team, position behind them first and use Alistar W Headbutt. To peel Blitzcrank off your backline, knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push him away with Alistar W Headbutt.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance himself, so once you reach him, lock him down with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt miss, you will be counterattacked, so do not rush the engage.
Blitzcrank.phase: In mid game, use a missed Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank's low mana as an opportunity. In late game, Alistar deals very little damage, so focus on starting fights or protecting your team.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay near your backline allies to start the fight instead of focusing damage on Blitzcrank. Use Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt an enemy damage dealer's position or push away an enemy who reaches your backline. Do not activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will before engaging; use it when crowd control catches you or you start taking focused fire.

Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear first to reduce the risk of Brand P Blaze stacks and its explosion.
Brand.build: Most of Brand's damage is magic damage, and Brand P Blaze scales with maximum health, so it is better to avoid building health alone.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so right after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is an opportunity to close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. If you are not ablaze, Brand Q Sear cannot stun you, making that state favorable for an engage.
Brand.phase: The available information is insufficient to judge which side has the advantage in mid game.

Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions: it slows and can start stacking Braum P Concussive Blows. If you are marked, move out of range before further stun stacks build up. Watch the cast of Braum R Glacial Fissure and sidestep its line, then avoid the slow zone it leaves behind.
Braum.build: Build magic resistance first. Braum's main damage is magic damage, but his total damage is low. Focus more on avoiding the buildup of stun stacks from Braum P Concussive Blows and the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.fight: Close the gap and fight right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. Engage with Alistar W Headbutt when your ADC can follow up, then chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for crowd control. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will if Braum's crowd control catches you or you start taking focused fire.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions so they block Braum Q Winter's Bite, and avoid open lines directly between you and Braum. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opportunity when an enemy steps forward to last-hit, but engage only if your allied marksman can reliably follow up. If the opportunity is uncertain, save the mana-heavy engage and wait while trading with Alistar E Trample.
Braum.combo: Once Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, follow Alistar W Headbutt immediately with Alistar Q Pulverize to knock up the target you pushed. Stack damage with Alistar E Trample, then land the stun on your next basic attack. To push Braum toward your team, get behind him before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Braum.escape: The window to engage opens right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. If you blocked Braum Q Winter's Bite with minions or sidestepped Braum R Glacial Fissure, use Alistar W Headbutt to close the gap from a position where your team can follow up.
Braum.phase: In mid game, keep looking to engage when Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. In late game, Alistar deals very little damage, so focus on starting fights or protecting your team.
Braum.teamfight: Wait for Braum E Unbreakable to end or find an angle from the side so your ADC does not keep attacking into the front of the shield. Instead of pouring damage into Braum, disrupt the position of the target he is protecting with Alistar W Headbutt. Peel enemies off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt, and use Alistar R Unbreakable Will if you come under focused fire.

Heimerdinger.watch: When the landing marker appears, move sideways to avoid its center. If it hits you, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the crowd control and leave turret range. While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, watch for empowered grenades and rockets, and do not group in narrow spaces.
Heimerdinger.build: Magic resistance helps you withstand this opponent's damage more than armor. Also consider movement speed to walk out of telegraphed attack areas.
Heimerdinger.fight: Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and lock the target down with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample, but engage only when your ADC can follow up. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you start taking focused fire.
Heimerdinger.laning: Do not recklessly take waves within turret range or repeatedly trade head-on. Step forward after Heimerdinger uses his grenade or spends all his turret placement charges. If you commit both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize and fail, you invite a counterattack. When the angle is uncertain, hold the engage and look for a trade with Alistar E Trample.
Heimerdinger.combo: When you reach Heimerdinger, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock him up. Activate Alistar E Trample, stack its damage, and follow with the basic attack stun. To send Heimerdinger toward your team, get behind him first to line up Alistar W Headbutt. If you cannot reach that position, knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize first, then use Alistar W Headbutt to push him in the direction you want.
Heimerdinger.escape: Being beside a turret that was just placed or has just finished a powerful shot also gives you an opening to engage. If the grenade hits you, do not remain within range of a turret that has immediately become fully charged.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the late game, Alistar should focus on engaging and protecting allies rather than dealing damage directly.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Approach Heimerdinger from the side instead of pushing straight through his turret setup, then disrupt his position with Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, do not group with your team in a narrow passage or at one spot in front of an objective. If you come under focused fire after engaging, survive with Alistar R Unbreakable Will. Peel enemies off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt.

Hwei.watch: Hwei E Subject: Torment can root you or push and pull you into follow-up attacks, so do not rush an engage while it is available. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on maximum or missing health. If the first ability hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary combo.
Hwei.build: Build magic resistance first against Hwei's damage. Because Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage proportional to maximum health, avoid building only large amounts of health. Also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas and tenacity against Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave. Follow with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample to chain crowd control, and fight when your team can follow up.
Hwei.laning: Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize angle when Hwei steps forward to last hit. Missing after using both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize leaves you open to a counterattack and costs a lot of mana. If your ADC cannot follow up, wait and trade with Alistar E Trample instead. If Hwei's first ability hits you, keep moving to break the combo.
Hwei.combo: For a standard engage, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock the target up. Then stack damage with Alistar E Trample and land the stun on your next basic attack. To push Hwei toward your team, get behind him first.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so engage with Alistar W Headbutt when Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. If Hwei E Subject: Torment has already caught you, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove the crowd control and reduce damage. Alistar R Unbreakable Will does not prevent new crowd control after use, so do not use it before engaging.
Hwei.phase: In mid game, engage when Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. In late game, Alistar deals less damage, so focus on starting fights and protecting your team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Hwei.teamfight: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, approach with Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt Hwei's position. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will when crowd control catches you or you start taking focused fire. If an enemy reaches your backline, knock them up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push them away with Alistar W Headbutt.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, so move behind minions or out of range to avoid it. If the circle left by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra hits you, leave it before it explodes again shortly afterward. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move far enough away to break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. Get movement speed as well so you can break the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve and leave the area left by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Karma.fight: Draw out Karma W Focused Resolve, then engage after the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra ends. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for crowd control. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will if the root catches you or you start taking focused fire.
Karma.laning: Taking Karma's abilities for free speeds up the cooldown of Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire, so stand behind minions or out of range. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize angle when an opponent steps up to last hit, but engage only when your ADC can follow up. If the angle is uncertain, save the mana-heavy combo and trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Karma.combo: Once Karma W Focused Resolve is used, follow Alistar W Headbutt immediately with Alistar Q Pulverize to knock her up. Stack damage with Alistar E Trample, then land the stun on your next basic attack. To send Karma toward your team, get behind her before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Karma.escape: Engaging when Karma W Focused Resolve is used reduces the risk of a root stopping you. Wait for the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra to end as well, then close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt.
Karma.phase: In mid game, engage when both Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra have been used. In late game, Alistar deals very little damage, so focus on starting fights and protecting your team.
Karma.teamfight: Karma W Focused Resolve can stop your engage while it is available, so draw it out before going in. If the shield from Karma E empowered by Karma R Mantra covers nearby allies, wait for it to end before engaging. Use Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize to disrupt enemy positioning or peel enemies off your backline, and survive focused fire with Alistar R Unbreakable Will.

Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can knock up Alistar and stop his engage, so move out of its path when you hear the tornado. Janna R Monsoon pushes nearby enemies away and resets the fight, so, if possible, save Alistar Q Pulverize to interrupt it.
Janna.build: The source does not specify a first item, so no particular purchase order can be set. If you build resistance against Janna's damage, magic resistance is the right type, but prioritize movement speed to dodge telegraphed attacks over building resistance because of Janna.
Janna.fight: Do not focus damage on a target shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Use up the shield, then engage when your allies can follow up. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then follow with Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample.
Janna.laning: Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look for an opening after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr miss. If you use both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt and fail, you will be counterattacked. If the opening is uncertain, trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Janna.combo: The basic engage is Alistar W Headbutt followed immediately by Alistar Q Pulverize to knock the target up, then build up Alistar E Trample and stun with your next basic attack. To send Janna toward your allies, first get behind her to line up Alistar W Headbutt.
Janna.escape: Janna has no separate mobility ability, but Janna Q Howling Gale can stop an engage, and Janna R Monsoon pushes Alistar away. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt while those abilities are down. If Janna Q Howling Gale catches you, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove the crowd control affecting you.
Janna.phase: The source does not provide enough information to determine who has the advantage in the mid game. In the late game, Alistar deals almost no damage, so focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna stays behind an allied damage dealer, she may keep pushing back your engages. Establish vision and look for a moment when Janna is isolated. Save Alistar Q Pulverize for Janna R Monsoon, and use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focused attacks while disrupting enemy positioning or peeling enemies off your backline.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade passes through targets in a line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so do not stand in line with your allied marksman. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch whether she is close enough to reach you rather than whether she has used it. When Leona W Eclipse activates, leave its range before it detonates. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the central stun.
Leona.build: If Leona's crowd control is getting you killed, consider tenacity first. Build resistance against the damage type of the enemy carry attacking you while Leona holds you in place. Magic resistance reduces damage from Leona P Sunlight, Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, and Leona W Eclipse.
Leona.fight: Right after Leona uses Leona E Zenith Blade is a chance to close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. If your allied marksman can reliably follow up, chain crowd control with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If the opening is uncertain, save the Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt combo; trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Leona.laning: Account for Leona's high early armor: avoid trades centered on physical damage, and counterattack after she uses Leona E Zenith Blade. Do not stand in line with your allied marksman; this gives Leona E Zenith Blade fewer paths to a deeper target. Alistar's early combo costs a lot of mana, so engage only when allies can follow up.
Leona.combo: If Leona has used Leona E Zenith Blade and your allies can follow up, knock her up with Alistar W Headbutt → Alistar Q Pulverize, then continue with Alistar E Trample. Once Alistar E Trample has dealt enough damage to champions, stun with your next basic attack. If Leona reaches your backline, use Alistar Q Pulverize → Alistar W Headbutt to knock her up and push her away.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is Leona's only mobility tool, so right after she uses it is an opening to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. Right after Leona's crowd control catches you, or when you start taking focused fire, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the disabling effects on you and reduce incoming damage. Alistar R Unbreakable Will does not prevent new crowd control after activation, so check whether Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare is still available.
Leona.phase: The provided information is insufficient to judge who has the advantage in mid game. Alistar deals little damage late game, so focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Leona.teamfight: If Leona reaches your backline with Leona E Zenith Blade, peel her off with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt. A Leona P Sunlight mark signals an enemy follow-up attack, so retreat instead of moving forward. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to reduce damage while disrupting enemy positioning and protecting allies.

Lulu.watch: If you engage with Alistar W Headbutt while Lulu W Whimsy is available, its silence can stop your follow-up. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so do not dive deep expecting a certain kill on a target while it is available. Move out of the indicated area to avoid the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance.
Lulu.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Lulu's indicated attack areas. Magic resistance helps against Lulu's damage, but choose your overall resistances based on the damage type of the target she protects. Also consider tenacity against the disabling effects of Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when Lulu steps forward to last-hit, but hold your engage if Lulu W Whimsy is available or your allies cannot follow up. If Alistar P Triumphant Roar is nearly fully stacked, apply one more crowd control effect after trading to heal, then retreat.
Lulu.combo: Once Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy, use Alistar W Headbutt → Alistar Q Pulverize to knock her up immediately as she is pushed back. Then stack damage with Alistar E Trample and stun her with your next basic attack. To send Lulu toward your allies, position yourself behind her before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to create distance on her own, so the moment she uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally is an opportunity to engage. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then hold her with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If Lulu R Wild Growth is still available, reconsider whether to dive deep onto the target she protects.
Lulu.phase: Late game, Alistar should focus on engaging and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Lulu.teamfight: If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, do not count on a certain kill against the target she can protect; look at Lulu herself or another target. Use Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt an enemy carry's positioning, or Alistar Q Pulverize → Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. If you come under focused fire after engaging, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to reduce damage.
Lulu.fight: Early on, trade with Alistar E Trample while waiting for an opening. If Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally and your allied marksman can follow up, close the gap and fight with Alistar W Headbutt. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you come under focused fire or right after a disabling effect catches you.

Lux.watch: Getting caught by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy to take her follow-up abilities, so bait it out, dodge it, then approach. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge sideways when the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears. If one of Lux's abilities hits you, keep your distance to avoid the basic attack that triggers the Lux P Illumination mark.
Lux.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Lux's indicated attack areas. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux P Illumination, Lux Q Light Binding, and Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: The moment you bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, engage with Alistar W Headbutt if your allied marksman can follow up. Knock Lux up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then continue with Alistar E Trample and aim for the stun.
Lux.laning: Do not stand in line with an ally. If Lux steps forward after missing Lux Q Light Binding, look for an engage. Missing both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt leaves you open to a counterattack, so save the combo when the opening is uncertain and trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Lux.combo: When Lux misses Lux Q Light Binding, use Alistar W Headbutt → Alistar Q Pulverize to chain the displacement into a knockup. Stack damage with Alistar E Trample, then stun with your next basic attack. To send Lux toward your allies, first get behind her and use Alistar W Headbutt, or knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize and then use Alistar W Headbutt in the desired direction.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so right after she misses Lux Q Light Binding is an opportunity to engage. Approach from a brush or the side, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then hold her with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Lux.phase: The provided information is insufficient to judge who has the advantage in mid game, so look for openings when Lux misses Lux Q Light Binding. Late game, Alistar deals almost no damage, so focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from different directions so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot block you together. Use Alistar to move Lux toward your allies, or peel an enemy off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize → Alistar W Headbutt. When you start taking focused fire, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will and disrupt the enemy formation.

Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, so stay out of its range near brush while it is available. Maokai E Sapling Toss planted in brush creates a bigger explosion, so take care when entering brush. The root from Maokai R Nature's Grasp lasts longer when it comes from far away, so dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.
Maokai.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave Maokai's indicated attack areas. Consider tenacity against the roots from Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp. Build resistances against the damage type of the enemy carry attacking you while Maokai holds you in place.
Maokai.fight: Right after Maokai uses Maokai W Twisted Advance, close the gap and start a fight with Alistar W Headbutt. Repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities brings back the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic sooner, so use your abilities on the enemy carry when possible. If you are rooted or start taking focused fire after engaging, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will.
Maokai.laning: While Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, stay out of its range near brush. Step forward and trade right after he uses it. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when the enemy carry steps forward to last-hit and your allied marksman can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, save the mana-heavy Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize combo; trade with Alistar E Trample while you wait.
Maokai.combo: Once Maokai uses Maokai W Twisted Advance, engage with Alistar W Headbutt, immediately knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then follow through to the Alistar E Trample stun. To send an enemy toward your allies, position yourself behind them before using Alistar W Headbutt. To peel Maokai off your backline, knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push him outward with Alistar W Headbutt.
Maokai.escape: Right after you force Maokai to use Maokai W Twisted Advance is Alistar's opening to engage. Maokai cannot be targeted during its dash, so wait until he lands, then close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and hold him with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Maokai.phase: The provided information is insufficient to judge who has the advantage in mid game. Late game, Alistar deals almost no damage, so focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Maokai.teamfight: When Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, move perpendicular to its direction of travel and fight in open terrain if possible. Push an enemy carry toward your allies, or use Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. If you are rooted or start taking focused fire, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will and disrupt the enemy formation.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so do not engage hastily while it is available. Delay frontline fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and extends the enemy marksman's range. Milio R Breath of Life cleanses immobilizing effects, but it cannot remove the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize.
Milio.build: Do not choose your resistances based on Milio alone; check the enemy damage dealer's damage type first. Build magic resistance if you need to withstand the magic damage from Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. Get healing reduction earlier if the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem.
Milio.fight: Engage after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is used and your marksman can follow up. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, knock the target up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then use Alistar E Trample to seek a stun. If the opening is uncertain, trade with Alistar E Trample and wait instead of spending mana on a full engage.
Milio.laning: Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when the enemy steps up to last-hit, but engage only if your marksman can follow up. Early on, use your combo sparingly so a failed engage does not cost you both mana and lane control.
Milio.combo: For a standard engage, use Alistar W Headbutt into Alistar Q Pulverize to knock the target up. Follow with Alistar E Trample to build up damage and seek a stun on your next basic attack. To send Milio toward your team, get behind him before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits to disengage, so engage with Alistar W Headbutt after he uses it. Milio has no mobility ability, making it easier to follow up with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample once you close the gap. Even if Milio R Breath of Life is available, it cannot remove the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize.
Milio.phase: In mid game, check whether Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick has been used before deciding to engage or protect your team. Milio's composition grows stronger over time while Alistar's damage falls off, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies in late game.
Milio.teamfight: Milio has no mobility ability and low defensive stats, so you can target him first after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is used. Use the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize to engage, since Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove it. Delay risky frontline fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active. If an enemy reaches your backline, peel them off with Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt.

Morgana.watch: Getting hit by Morgana Q Dark Binding lets Morgana follow up with Morgana W Tormented Shadow and further attacks, so keep minions between you and her to avoid the root. When low on health, stay out of Morgana W Tormented Shadow's area. If caught by Morgana R Soul Shackles, use Alistar W Headbutt to get out of range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana's main damage. If long roots and stuns are getting you killed, consider tenacity first. When fights run long enough for the healing from Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow to become a problem, get healing reduction.
Morgana.fight: Engage after dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding and once Morgana E Black Shield has been used. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then chain crowd control with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If the opening is uncertain, trade with Alistar E Trample instead of spending mana on a full engage.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana to maintain an angle that avoids Morgana Q Dark Binding. When the enemy steps up to last-hit, engage with Alistar Q Pulverize if your marksman can follow up. If you use both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt and fail, you will be counterattacked, so wait out uncertain engages.
Morgana.combo: After Morgana E Black Shield is used, follow Alistar W Headbutt immediately with Alistar Q Pulverize to knock up the target you pushed. Then build up damage with Alistar E Trample and follow through to a stun on your next basic attack. To send Morgana toward your team, get behind her before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Morgana.escape: Engage during the window after both Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are used. Morgana has no ability to create distance herself, giving you a chance to close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt.
Morgana.phase: In the mid game, keep dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding and look for opportunities when Morgana E Black Shield is on cooldown. In the late game, Alistar should focus on engaging and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Morgana.teamfight: Do not waste crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. Use Alistar W Headbutt to push an enemy damage dealer toward your team, or use Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. When you start taking focused fire, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will and disrupt the enemy formation.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is his main engage tool, so keep minions between you and him to avoid it. Do not stay within basic attack range after a trade, or Nautilus P Staggering Blow's first basic attack can root you. Nautilus R Depth Charge can knock up your allies too, so do not stand on top of each other while it is available.
Nautilus.build: Prioritize magic resistance for your first defensive choice. The main damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, Nautilus W Titan's Wrath, and Nautilus E Riptide is magic damage. If you repeatedly die while locked down by crowd control, you can prioritize tenacity.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt to start a fight. Knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then follow with Alistar E Trample to seek a stun. If Nautilus uses Nautilus E Riptide right next to you, do not rush to move before its waves finish.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when the enemy steps up to last-hit. If you use both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize and fail, you will be counterattacked, so engage only when your marksman can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, save mana and wait for a chance to trade with Alistar E Trample.
Nautilus.combo: Once Nautilus Q Dredge Line is used, follow Alistar W Headbutt immediately with Alistar Q Pulverize to knock up Nautilus as he is pushed away. Then build up damage with Alistar E Trample and seek a stun on your next basic attack. If you need to peel Nautilus off an ally, use Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt to push him away.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. While Nautilus Q Dredge Line, his mobility tool, is unavailable, follow up with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. After the trade, leave basic attack range to avoid Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.phase: In mid game, continue choosing windows when Nautilus Q Dredge Line is unavailable to engage. In late game, Alistar deals little damage, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies.
Nautilus.teamfight: While Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, do not stand on top of an ally along its path. Peel Nautilus off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize into Alistar W Headbutt. If Nautilus catches you with crowd control or you start taking focused fire, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will and focus on disrupting the enemy's positioning.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting a target in front, so do not stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup of Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; spread out as soon as a suspicious target gets close. If rooted or stunned, you can use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the crowd control, but it will not prevent new crowd control applied afterward.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko's main damage. Prioritize tenacity if getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom is getting you killed. Get movement speed as well to escape the area of Neeko's telegraphed attack.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt to trade. Knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize and keep Alistar E Trample active to follow through to a stun on your next basic attack. Neeko has relatively low magic resistance, so Alistar's main magic damage also hits her hard.
Neeko.laning: When Neeko steps up to last-hit, look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening. If the opening is uncertain, do not spend mana and use both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize. After the trade, if Alistar P Triumphant Roar is nearly fully stacked, land one more crowd control effect to heal yourself and nearby allies, then back off.
Neeko.combo: For a standard engage, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock up Neeko as she is pushed away. Then build up damage with Alistar E Trample and follow through to a stun with a basic attack. To send Neeko toward your team, get behind her before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is a good window to close in. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; confirm where the real Neeko is.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, Alistar focuses on initiating fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Neeko.teamfight: If someone you suspect is Neeko approaches, spread out from your allies so Neeko R Pop Blossom cannot hit several of you. When Neeko engages herself, stop her with Alistar Q Pulverize or Alistar W Headbutt, and leave the area if you see the windup of Neeko R Pop Blossom. Once the fight starts, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focused fire while pushing Neeko out of position or protecting your backline.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison is a slow stun skill, so sidestep when you see its warning. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it, and watch for Nami Q Aqua Prison afterward. Avoid fighting an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing head-on; wait for the effect to end.
Nami.build: To counter the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow, get healing reduction from Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon first. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Nami's damage. Also consider movement speed to walk out of telegraphed ability areas.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. If your ADC can follow up, chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for crowd control. If the opening is uncertain, trade with Alistar E Trample and wait instead of committing to a mana-heavy engage.
Nami.laning: Nami has low health and no mobility skill, so establish vision and target her. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when Nami steps forward, but check whether your team can follow up: if both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize miss, you are vulnerable to a counterattack. If crowd control has fully stacked Alistar P Triumphant Roar, take the heal and back off.
Nami.combo: For a standard engage, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock the target up, then stack Alistar E Trample for a stun on your next basic attack. To push Nami toward your team, first position behind her, then use Alistar W Headbutt. You can also Flash during Alistar Q Pulverize to knock her up from an unexpected range, then push her toward your team with Alistar W Headbutt.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility skill, so immediately after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is an opening to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave, watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows, then engage. Wait out the effect of Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing while it is active.
Nami.phase: In the mid game, look to engage when Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. In the late game, Alistar focuses on initiating fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Nami.teamfight: Use Alistar W Headbutt to push an enemy damage dealer toward your team, or use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. If Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave catches you with crowd control, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to break free and take advantage of its damage reduction when focused. Alistar R Unbreakable Will does not prevent new crowd control after activation, so keep watching for Nami's follow-up abilities.

Pyke.watch: Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns along the line of his dash, so move sideways away from the direction he came from. If the shark indicator from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive appears beneath you, move toward your team. When your health is low, watch for the range of Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.build: Pyke Q Bone Skewer, Pyke E Phantom Undertow, and Pyke R Death From Below all deal physical damage, so choose Plated Steelcaps and build armor. Also build health, accounting for Pyke's armor penetration and the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.fight: After sidestepping Pyke E Phantom Undertow, engage with Alistar W Headbutt if your ADC can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, avoid spending mana on both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize; trade with Alistar E Trample and wait for an opportunity.
Pyke.laning: Keep Pyke in vision as he retreats after a trade to prevent the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.combo: When engaging, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock the target up, then follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample. If Pyke reaches your backline, knock him up first with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push him outward with Alistar W Headbutt.
Pyke.escape: Dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow creates an opening while one of his engage and escape tools is unavailable. If Pyke R Death From Below is also still unavailable, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and lock him down with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Pyke.phase: In the mid game, engage when Pyke E Phantom Undertow and Pyke R Death From Below are unavailable. In the late game, Alistar deals less damage, so start fights or protect your team, and watch for Pyke's chain of executions.
Pyke.teamfight: Pyke can target multiple low-health allies in succession with Pyke R Death From Below, so have injured allies spread out.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns a champion, so your first priority is staying out of its range. Do not attack Pantheon from the front during Pantheon E Aegis Assault; wait for it to end or move to his side.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon Q Comet Spear and Pantheon W Shield Vault are among his main sources of damage and deal physical damage, so build armor first. Boots of Swiftness are generally valuable on Alistar, but choose Plated Steelcaps if the enemy team deals mostly physical damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone.
Pantheon.fight: Wait for an opening outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range, then engage when Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you can reach his side. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize, and follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample. If you are focused immediately after engaging, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. Pantheon is strong in early trades, so do not force them. When an enemy steps forward to last-hit, engage if your ADC can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, save mana instead of using both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize, and trade with Alistar E Trample.
Pantheon.combo: When engaging, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock the target up and chain crowd control. Stack Alistar E Trample damage, then follow through with the stun on your next basic attack. If Pantheon reaches your backline, knock him up first with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push him outward with Alistar W Headbutt.
Pantheon.escape: Pantheon W Shield Vault being unavailable is an opening to engage, especially if Pantheon R Grand Starfall has not come back up. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and lock him down with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is unavailable, bear in mind that he can escape with his remaining movement tools.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon is strong in early trades, so avoid giving up kills and buy time. In the mid game, keep looking for openings when Pantheon's mobility skill is unavailable. In the late game, focus on Alistar's ability to start fights and protect allies rather than on Pantheon, whose impact falls off.
Pantheon.teamfight: When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area. If Pantheon reaches your backline, peel him off with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt. If you are stunned, break free with Alistar R Unbreakable Will. When attacking, avoid the front of Pantheon E Aegis Assault and focus on disrupting the enemy's positioning.

Rakan.watch: The landing point of Rakan W Grand Entrance is visible in advance, so sidestep as his dash begins to avoid the knockup. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, do not stand in a line; interrupt him with Alistar Q Pulverize or Alistar W Headbutt before he reaches you. If you are already under crowd control, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove it, but it will not prevent crowd control applied afterward.
Rakan.build: Get a way to remove crowd control first. If building resistance, build magic resistance against Rakan's damage.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers breaks. If Rakan W Grand Entrance misses and your allies can follow up, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt and chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for crowd control.
Rakan.laning: Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when an enemy steps forward to last-hit. An engage that uses both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt leaves you vulnerable to a counterattack if it fails, so commit only when your ADC can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, save mana, trade with Alistar E Trample, and wait.
Rakan.combo: When Rakan W Grand Entrance is unavailable, use Alistar W Headbutt followed by Alistar Q Pulverize to knock him up, then follow with Alistar E Trample and look for the stun on your next basic attack. To peel Rakan off your backline, use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to push him outward.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance is used is your window to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. If Rakan is separated from his allies, he cannot use Rakan E Battle Dance on them, so look for a chance to catch him then.
Rakan.phase: The provided information is insufficient to judge which side has the advantage in the mid game. In the late game, Alistar focuses on starting fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Rakan.teamfight: Immediately after Rakan W Grand Entrance lands, use Alistar Q Pulverize or Alistar W Headbutt to interrupt his move in and out. Do not stand in a line where Rakan R The Quickness can catch multiple allies. Push enemies toward your team or peel them off your backline, and activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you start taking focused fire.

Rell.watch: When Rell and an ally speed up with Rell E Full Tilt, they may engage soon. Stop trading and back out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. Sidestep Rell Q Shattering Strike, which travels in a straight line, and keep space between allies so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull several of you together.
Rell.build: Build magic resistance first against Rell’s main damage. Rell P Break the Mold reduces resistances, and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on resistances or health alone; prepare for her crowd control too.
Rell.fight: When Rell approaches while mounted, wait outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. If it misses and Rell E Full Tilt is also down, close in with Alistar W Headbutt, then chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample to keep her controlled.
Rell.laning: Early on, use Rell’s low magic resistance to trade when your allied marksman can follow up. If you use both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt and the engage fails, you will be counterattacked, so if the opening is uncertain, trade with Alistar E Trample and wait. If crowd control has nearly filled the stacks for Alistar P Triumphant Roar, apply it once more to trigger the heal, then back off.
Rell.combo: When engaging, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock Rell up, then stack Alistar E Trample to follow with a stun. If Rell reaches your backline, knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then push her away with Alistar W Headbutt.
Rell.escape: Do not rush an engage when only Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; she can escape with Rell E Full Tilt. Once both movement abilities are down, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, especially before Rell E Full Tilt comes back. If you are already caught by Rell’s crowd control, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the disabling effects and reduce incoming damage.
Rell.phase: Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to heal during the laning phase, so look for trades then. The available information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the mid game. In the late game, Alistar focuses on initiating fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Rell.teamfight: Before a teamfight, spread out so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull you and your allies together. If Rell dives your backline, peel her off with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt. When you engage, focus on disrupting Rell’s position. Activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you are caught by crowd control or start taking focused fire.

Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, you are rooted and then thrown, potentially stunning an ally as well. Avoid it from behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover makes you attack nearby allies, so do not engage while grouped tightly. Immediately after being caught, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the disabling effects.
Renata.build: Renata Glasc’s damaging abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. Renata Glasc P Leverage scales with maximum health, so avoid building only a large health pool. Also get movement speed to leave the area of Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Renata.fight: When Renata Glasc steps forward, close the gap and start a fight with Alistar W Headbutt if your allied marksman can follow up. After engaging, knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize and follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample. If you kill an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, keep your distance together with your allies so that enemy cannot participate in a takedown.
Renata.laning: Renata Glasc has low health and attack damage early and no movement ability of her own, so pressure her when she steps forward to last-hit. If you use both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt and fail to engage, you will be counterattacked; engage only when your allies can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, conserve mana and wait for a chance to trade with Alistar E Trample.
Renata.combo: If you can reach Renata Glasc, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock her up, then stun her with Alistar E Trample. To send her toward your allies, position behind her first, then use Alistar W Headbutt.
Renata.escape: After Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, you have a good window to close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. She has no movement ability of her own, so once you reach her, hold her in place with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is still available, keep space between you and your allies as you engage.
Renata.phase: In mid game, still choose engages your allies can follow up on, and watch for an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout participating in a takedown. Late game, Alistar deals little damage, so focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Renata.teamfight: If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is still available, keep space between you and your allies as you engage. Use Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt an enemy damage dealer’s position, or peel an enemy off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt. Activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you are caught by crowd control or start taking focused fire.

Seraphine.watch: If you are slowed by Seraphine E Beat Drop, standing directly in its path can leave you rooted, so move out of its line immediately after it hits. In teamfights, stand spread out side to side: Seraphine R Encore extends its range each time it reaches an ally. If you are caught by crowd control, Alistar R Unbreakable Will can remove it, but it does not prevent new crowd control applied afterward.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Seraphine Q High Note, and Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no resistance reduction or true damage, so the magic resistance you build remains effective.
Seraphine.laning: Use Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize together only when your allied marksman can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, conserve mana and wait for a chance to trade with Alistar E Trample.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, use Alistar W Headbutt followed immediately by Alistar Q Pulverize to knock Seraphine up where you pushed her. Then stack Alistar E Trample damage and stun her with your next basic attack. To send Seraphine toward your allies, get behind her first, then use Alistar W Headbutt.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no movement ability, so immediately after you avoid Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. If you are slowed, first move out of the line of Seraphine E Beat Drop to avoid the root.
Seraphine.phase: In mid game, take openings when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down to start fights with Alistar W Headbutt. Late game, Alistar deals less damage, so focus on pushing Seraphine toward your allies or protecting them.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out side to side so Seraphine R Encore cannot extend its range through your allies. After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, disrupt Seraphine’s position with Alistar W Headbutt, and activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you start taking focused fire. Push enemies who reach your backline away with Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine stands alone away from an allied marksman or just after she uses Seraphine E Beat Drop. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize, then follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample.

Sona.watch: A basic attack empowered by Sona P Power Chord can slow you, so back away if Sona suddenly enters basic attack range. Sona R Crescendo can stun allies standing in a line, so spread out side to side and watch for Sona stepping forward.
Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against Sona’s main damage. Make sure your team also has at least one healing reduction item for her late-game healing.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply an aura, close the gap and fight with Alistar W Headbutt if your allied marksman can follow up. Knock her up with Alistar Q Pulverize before she escapes with Sona E Song of Celerity, then follow with the stun from Alistar E Trample.
Sona.laning: Force a trade when Sona steps forward. If your allies cannot follow up, save your mana instead of engaging and wait for an opportunity with Alistar E Trample.
Sona.combo: Use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock Sona up where you pushed her. Then stack Alistar E Trample damage and stun her with the empowered basic attack. To send Sona toward your allies, position behind her first, then use Alistar W Headbutt.
Sona.escape: Sona has no ability to create distance on her own, so look for a chance to engage with Alistar W Headbutt after Sona R Crescendo is down. Catch her with the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize before she gains movement speed from Sona E Song of Celerity.
Sona.phase: In the mid game, keep in mind that Sona grows stronger as she gains stacks, and pressure her when opportunities arise. In the late game, Sona's auras and healing grow stronger, so Alistar focuses on initiating fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out side to side so Sona R Crescendo cannot hit several allies at once. Use Alistar W Headbutt to push Sona away from an allied group and disrupt where her auras can reach. If Sona R Crescendo stuns you, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the disabling effect and reduce incoming damage.

Senna.watch: Senna W Last Embrace takes time to root after it hits, so dodge it from behind minions. If its mark lands on you, move away from allies. Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through its target, so stay off the line between Senna and a minion or ally in front of you. If Senna hits you once, back off to deny the second attack and prevent her from collecting Mist.
Senna.build: Build armor first against Senna's main damage. If the enemy team also deals mostly physical damage, choose Plated Steelcaps; otherwise, consider Boots of Swiftness to help you engage. Build armor alongside health instead of stacking health alone.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps up to collect a soul, engage only if your allied marksman can follow up. If the opening is uncertain, save the mana cost of using Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize together; trade with Alistar E Trample and wait. If Senna W Last Embrace roots you, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the crowd control and withstand focus fire.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls fall and pressure the path Senna takes to collect them. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opening when she steps up for a last hit, too. After she pokes you once, avoid the second attack. If Alistar P Triumphant Roar is nearly ready, land one more crowd control effect to heal, then back off.
Senna.combo: To close the gap, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock Senna up, then follow with Alistar E Trample for a stun. To send Senna toward your allies, first get behind her, then use Alistar W Headbutt. From an unexpected distance, you can Flash during the Alistar Q Pulverize cast to move its area onto her, then use Alistar W Headbutt to push her toward your allies.
Senna.escape: Once Senna W Last Embrace is down, you can engage without worrying about its root. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then hold her with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If you see enemies approaching under Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to a place where you can see them instead of holding your position.
Senna.phase: In mid game, keep catching Senna when she steps up to collect souls to slow her scaling. Late game, Senna gains range and attack damage while Alistar's damage becomes less effective, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off and watch for the enemy's approach from a place with vision, or use Alistar Q Pulverize in the mist to stop an engage. When an opening appears, disrupt Senna's position and push her toward your allies. Use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to peel enemies off your backline. Once you draw focus fire, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to reduce the damage while disrupting their formation.

Soraka.watch: Entering Soraka E Equinox silences you, so use Alistar W Headbutt before stepping into its area when you engage. Soraka Q Starcall heals her and grants movement speed if it hits you, so dodge it as you close the gap.
Soraka.build: Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If fights last long enough for Soraka's healing to become a problem, get healing reduction next.
Soraka.fight: Engage when Soraka E Equinox is down and your allied marksman can follow up.
Soraka.laning: Have your allied marksman pressure the enemy into making Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall so she cannot heal herself. If the engage is uncertain, save the mana cost of using Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize together; trade with Alistar E Trample and wait.
Soraka.combo: Once Soraka E Equinox is down, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock her up, then follow with the Alistar E Trample stun. To send Soraka toward your allies, get behind her before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Soraka.escape: Immediately after Soraka uses Soraka E Equinox to poke or clear the wave is your chance to engage. She has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt at that point and hold her with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Soraka.phase: Keep looking for openings when Soraka E Equinox is down in mid game. As Alistar's damage becomes less effective late game, focus on engaging and protecting allies.
Soraka.teamfight: Look for a chance to engage on Soraka and kill her first instead of continuing to hit an enemy she is healing. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focus fire while disrupting Soraka's position, or peel an enemy off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and back, so stay clear of its path until it disappears completely, even after dodging the outward wave. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with more overlapping bolts up close, so keep your distance before engaging. When Swain R Demonic Ascension activates, leave its range and wait for it to end.
Swain.build: Swain's damaging abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. Get healing reduction if fights drag on or if you need to counter the healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension later in the game.
Swain.fight: Right after Swain E Nevermove is down, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then chain crowd control with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If the engage is uncertain, save your mana instead of using the combo; trade with Alistar E Trample and wait for an opening.
Swain.laning: Look for the moment Swain steps forward, but engage with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt only when your allied marksman can clearly follow up. If you use both abilities and fail, you will be counterattacked, so dodge the outward and return paths of Swain E Nevermove while waiting for an opening. Pressure Swain early to slow his Swain P Ravenous Flock scaling.
Swain.combo: Once Swain E Nevermove is down, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock him up, then follow with the Alistar E Trample stun. If you need to push Swain toward your allies, get behind him before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Swain.escape: Right after Swain E Nevermove is down is your chance to engage with Alistar W Headbutt. Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so once you close the gap, you can hold him with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Swain.phase: Keep looking for openings when Swain E Nevermove is down in mid game. Swain grows stronger over time while Alistar's damage becomes insufficient, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies late game.
Swain.teamfight: During Swain R Demonic Ascension, leave its range and wait for it to end instead of continuing to fight beside him. When you fight again, use Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt an enemy's position, or use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline.

Thresh.fight: Dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence sideways, then close the gap. Thresh stepping up to collect a soul is also a good time to trade. After engaging, prepare the Alistar E Trample stun, and activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will when you start taking focus fire.
Thresh.laning: Look for Thresh stepping up to collect a soul or an enemy stepping up for a last hit, but engage only when your allied marksman can follow up. Early on, the mana cost is high, so if the opening is uncertain, avoid using Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt together; trade with Alistar E Trample and wait.
Thresh.combo: When Thresh's movement tools are unavailable, approach with Alistar W Headbutt and immediately knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize. Then stack Alistar E Trample damage to land the stun on your next basic attack. To push Thresh toward your allies, first get behind him, or knock him up with Alistar Q Pulverize before using Alistar W Headbutt.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down, engage with Alistar W Headbutt before it comes back up, then chain Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample. If only one of Thresh's movement tools is down, account for the one he still has before engaging.
Thresh.phase: In mid game, Thresh gains armor as he collects souls, so catch him when he steps up to collect one. Alistar's damage becomes less effective late game, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies.
Thresh.teamfight: Use Alistar W Headbutt to disrupt an enemy damage dealer's position, or use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline. If you are trapped in Thresh R The Box, choose a direction to escape; you can use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to reduce damage and take on the job of breaking through one wall. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, finish off the target immediately or back off.
Thresh.build: Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay lock you in place for allies to attack, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance against Thresh's ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence has a long cast animation, but if it hits, the stun lets him engage. Move sideways when he raises his hook, and change direction again when you step up for a last hit. Stay off the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward allies.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits to the sides, so stay alert even after dodging the initial projectile. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption catches you or you take several abilities in a row, you may also take true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Back off and let the stacks expire when they build up.
Velkoz.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave telegraphed attack areas. Build magic resistance against Vel'Koz's basic abilities, and health to withstand the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.fight: After Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. Follow up with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample for more crowd control, but engage only when your ADC can follow.
Velkoz.laning: Manage your distance so Vel'Koz cannot hit you with several abilities in a row. When Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits, dodge toward Vel'Koz or behind the path the projectile has passed. Clear vision in the river and tri-brush to create a flank. If the engage angle is uncertain, save your mana-intensive combo.
Velkoz.combo: Once Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, engage with Alistar W Headbutt into Alistar Q Pulverize, then stack Alistar E Trample to stun with your next basic attack. To send Vel'Koz toward your team, first move behind him, then use Alistar W Headbutt.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so the moment after you dodge Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your chance to engage. At very close range, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you away, so be ready to follow Alistar W Headbutt with Alistar Q Pulverize.
Velkoz.phase: In mid game, clear vision and approach from the side to make it hard for Vel'Koz to step forward and poke. Alistar deals little damage late game, so focus on starting fights and protecting your team.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with the crowd control from Alistar Q Pulverize or Alistar W Headbutt. If you are caught by crowd control during your engage or start taking focused damage, activate Alistar R Unbreakable Will. Then disrupt enemy positioning or peel enemies off your backline.

Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle stuns after a delay, so sidestep when you see its warning. When the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance activates, hold your damage until it ends.
Taric.build: Build magic resistance first. Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle both deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, engage when your ADC can follow. Do not keep taking empowered basic attacks from Taric P Bravado; use Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt to push Taric away from his basic attack target. Alistar's magic damage is effective against Taric's low magic resistance.
Taric.laning: Bait out Taric E Dazzle, then trade. Look for an Alistar Q Pulverize opportunity when Taric steps forward to last-hit, but commit both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt only when your team can follow. If the angle is uncertain, save mana and wait while trading with Alistar E Trample.
Taric.combo: Once Taric E Dazzle is down, use Alistar Q Pulverize immediately after Alistar W Headbutt to knock him up. Keep Alistar E Trample active to follow up with a stun on your next basic attack. This crowd control still works during the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance, so lock Taric down until it ends.
Taric.escape: After you dodge Taric E Dazzle or immediately after Taric uses it, you have an opening to engage. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Alistar W Headbutt and follow with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Taric.phase: The information provided is insufficient to judge who has the mid-game advantage. Late game, Alistar should focus on starting fights and protecting his team rather than dealing damage.
Taric.teamfight: When you see Taric R Cosmic Radiance being cast, quickly decide whether to end the fight before immunity activates or kill an enemy damage dealer. While immunity is active, use Alistar Q Pulverize, Alistar W Headbutt, and Alistar E Trample to control positioning and crowd control, then let your team deal damage after it ends. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focused damage while pushing an enemy damage dealer toward your team or peeling an enemy off your backline.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so do not rely on standing behind them. When you see him charging it, change direction and sidestep. Watch for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction and the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. In particular, if Xerath E Shocking Orb hits you and you start taking focused damage, use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to remove the crowd control and reduce the damage.
Xerath.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of telegraphed attack areas. Then build magic resistance against Xerath's magic damage; do not prioritize armor.
Xerath.fight: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt. When your ADC can follow, knock Xerath up with Alistar Q Pulverize and follow through to the stun from Alistar E Trample. If the engage angle is uncertain, save your mana-intensive combo and wait for a chance to trade with Alistar E Trample.
Xerath.laning: Sidestep the heavy damage from Xerath Q Arcanopulse, but do not overextend trying to dodge all his poke. Xerath spends a lot of mana in lane, so push the wave and call your jungler when his mana runs low. When Xerath steps forward to last-hit, check that your ADC can follow before engaging.
Xerath.combo: The standard engage is Alistar W Headbutt immediately into Alistar Q Pulverize to knock Xerath up. Then stack damage from Alistar E Trample to stun him with your next basic attack. To send Xerath toward your team, first position behind him, then use Alistar W Headbutt.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your opening to engage. You can also sidestep Xerath Q Arcanopulse as he charges it while closing the gap. When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast, dodge it or, if you can reach him, engage on Xerath while he cannot move.
Xerath.phase: In mid game, keep looking to close the gap when Xerath's stun and slow are down. Late game, Alistar deals almost no damage, so focus on starting fights and protecting your team.
Xerath.teamfight: When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast, dodge the attack or, if you can reach him, engage on Xerath while he cannot move. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focused damage while disrupting Xerath's position. Depending on the situation, use Alistar W Headbutt to send an enemy toward your team, or use Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt to peel an enemy off your backline.

Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb sticks to you, move away from allies and out of its blast radius. Engaging alone while slowed by Zilean E Time Warp makes you vulnerable to his bomb combo.
Zilean.build: Build tenacity first to reduce the impact of the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp. Then build magic resistance against Zilean’s magic damage.
Zilean.fight: Zilean has no mobility ability, so when you have a chance to close the gap, engage with Alistar W Headbutt. Follow the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize with the stun from Alistar E Trample, and fight when your allies can follow up. Alistar’s magic damage is effective against Zilean’s low magic resistance.
Zilean.laning: If you use both Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt and the engage fails, you can be counterattacked. Engage only when your ADC can follow up.
Zilean.combo: When approaching Zilean, use Alistar W Headbutt → Alistar Q Pulverize to chain the displacement into a knockup. Then stack damage with Alistar E Trample and land the basic attack stun. If you need to push Zilean toward your allies, position behind him first.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility ability, so you do not need to wait for one to be used. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt right after the slow from Zilean E Time Warp or the stun combo using Zilean Q Time Bomb and Zilean W Rewind has been used.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, Alistar should focus on starting fights and protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Zilean.teamfight: Engage together from multiple directions so Zilean E Time Warp cannot easily stop everyone. If an allied damage dealer has Zilean R Chronoshift, target Zilean himself and do not use abilities on the reviving target during that time. Use Alistar R Unbreakable Will to withstand focused attacks while disrupting enemy positioning or peeling enemies off your backline.

Zyra.watch: Sidestep the straight-line root from Zyra E Grasping Roots at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave its area; use Alistar W Headbutt to escape if needed. Avoid fighting where plants are clustered.
Zyra.build: Build movement speed first so you can walk out of telegraphed attack areas. Zyra’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance afterward.
Zyra.fight: Engage when Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and there are no plants nearby. Close the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, then chain crowd control with Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample.
Zyra.laning: Step on Zyra’s seeds along your path to remove them, but back off when she casts an ability, then approach again. After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, engage when your ADC can follow up. If you use both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize and the engage fails, you can be counterattacked, so wait if the opening is uncertain.
Zyra.combo: The standard engage is Alistar W Headbutt immediately followed by Alistar Q Pulverize to chain crowd control. Then stack damage with Alistar E Trample to stun her with your next basic attack. If you need to push Zyra toward your allies, position behind her first.
Zyra.escape: Right after Zyra E Grasping Roots misses is your chance to engage. Zyra has no mobility ability to create distance, so approach with Alistar W Headbutt and land Alistar Q Pulverize.
Zyra.phase: In the mid game, avoid areas where Zyra has had time to set up and fight where there are no plants. In the late game, Alistar deals little damage, so focus on starting fights and protecting allies.
Zyra.teamfight: Do not fight where Zyra has built up seeds; move the fight elsewhere. If Zyra E Grasping Roots has been used, approach and push Zyra toward your allies or knock her up. Peel enemies off your backline with Alistar Q Pulverize followed by Alistar W Headbutt.
